value.assessment_basis: Visual inspection of the supplied rendered page. Transcriptions include the affected text and identifying context. Numbering omissions are distinguished from typographic substitutions; these classifications do not determine legal applicability.

findings.assessment: The printed closing quotation mark is a double quotation mark. The right extraction substitutes a single quotation mark. This is a typographic punctuation difference.
The printed section number 7. precedes the underlined heading Product Category. The right extraction omits that number, removing an explicit structural identifier.
The paragraph number 7.1 is clearly printed in the left margin. Its deletion omits an explicit paragraph identifier; it is not merely a typographic difference.

printed_text: 7.1 Intermediaries should devise (or adjust as appropriate) Product Categories to categorise investment products based on the terms and features, characteristics, nature and extent of risks of investment product.

findings.assessment: The paragraph number 7.2 is clearly printed beside the opening sentence transcribed here. The right extraction omits this identifier; the listed difference is not merely typographic.

printed_text: 7.2 The SPI should specify the Product Categories within which investment transactions could be executed under a Streamlined Approach.

findings.assessment: The printed paragraph identifier 7.3 introduces the restriction and the alternatives in subparagraphs (a) and (b). The right extraction omits that identifier. The listed deletion does not itself remove the restriction or its alternatives.

printed_text: 7.3 Intermediaries should not apply the Streamlined Approach to investment transactions within a Product Category for an SPI unless –

findings.assessment: The printed dash after unless appears to be an en dash, consistent with the left extraction. The right extraction uses an em dash. This changes dash typography without changing the printed alternatives, the connecting or, the transaction count, or the time period.

printed_text: 7.3 Intermediaries should not apply the Streamlined Approach to investment transactions within a Product Category for an SPI unless –
(a) the SPI has met the criteria specified under paragraph 4.1(a) or (b) or (c) above; or
(b) the SPI has executed within such Product Category at least five transactions within the past three years (ie, the criteria specified under paragraph 4.1(d) above).
issues.uncertainty: The raster supports an en-dash reading, but the original encoded character cannot be established from the rendered image alone.

findings.assessment: The section number 8. is clearly printed before the underlined heading Streamlining Threshold. The right extraction omits an explicit section identifier; this is not merely a typographic difference.
The paragraph number 8.1 is clearly printed. The right extraction omits that identifier. The listed difference does not itself alter the absolute-amount or percentage alternatives in the paragraph.

printed_text: 8.1 The SPI should specify a maximum threshold of investment, as an absolute amount or a percentage relative to the SPI’s assets under management (“AUM”) with the intermediary, that is acceptable to be executed under a Streamlined Approach (“Streamlining Threshold”).

findings.assessment: The paragraph number 8.2 is clearly printed. The right extraction omits an explicit paragraph identifier; this is not merely a typographic difference.

printed_text: 8.2 SPI could specify a Streamlining Threshold appropriate to their circumstances and the intermediary is required to maintain proper records of setting any such threshold, including the SPI’s rationale that provides support for setting such threshold.
